visualCharacteristics: Adventure details specification list: repeating label/value pairs stacked vertically. Uppercase labels above values, each row marked with a yellow accent bar on the left. Light background, no images.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row = 2 cells: cell 1 = label, cell 2 = value.
usage: Key/value spec lists (e.g. adventure details: activity, trip length, group size, difficulty, price).
